A later 411px Classic return-target failure was repaired and independently rechecked on final 3ec5: after the leaving transition, focus is the visible navigation:open button. The mobile drawer also passes native Enter/Tab/Shift+Tab/Escape.

Studio-to-classic UI switching retains all three; return through the public host theme action retains all three in Studio. No create/publish/clear/download action is invoked. The original empty-library query-remount defect is separately reproduced/repaired in preview and component tests.
